name: phil-tools
description: Unofficial community tools for the Phil language.

scripts.build: npm run gen:otc && npm run build:core && npm run build:vscode && npm run build:playground && npm run build:site
scripts.gen: python3 vscode/scripts/gen-grammar.py && esbuild vscode/scripts/gen-docs.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/gen-docs.js --log-level=error && node out/gen-docs.js
scripts.test: npm run gen:otc && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:sim && npm run test:designer && npm run test:learn && npm run test:playground && npm run test:site && npm run test:philc && npm run test:fuzz && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:corpus: esbuild test/test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/test.js --log-level=error && cp node_modules/vscode-oniguruma/release/onig.wasm out/ && node out/test.js
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:vscode && cd vscode && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.test:philc: (command -v go >/dev/null && cd test/standin && GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm go build -o ../../out/standin.wasm main.go || echo "no Go: skipping the stand-in build") && esbuild test/philc-runner.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/philc-runner.js --log-level=error && node out/philc-runner.js
